title: Reflection-aware Generative Novel View Synthesis
abstract: arXiv:2609.05382v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We propose Ref-GeNVS, a training-free, reflection-aware method for generative novel view synthesis (NVS) in mirror scenes. Existing multi-view diffusion models often fail to recognize the mirror in the scene and cannot exploit reflected content for scene generation. To fix this issue without additional training, our key idea is to treat a mirror image as two complementary views. From input images, we estimate the mirror plane and reflect camera poses to form virtual views. Based on this virtual view setup, we propose a two-stage generation method consisting of Mirror-gated attention and Reflection injection, which enables reflection-consistent NVS by explicitly leveraging reflection relationships in a multi-view diffusion model. Ref-GeNVS inherits the strong generalizability of the multi-view diffusion backbone, while it does not require finetuning. translated_title: 反射感知的生成式新视角合成
translated_abstract: 我们提出了 Ref-GeNVS，这是一种无需训练、反射感知的镜像场景生成式新视角合成（NVS）方法。现有多视角扩散模型通常无法识别场景中的镜子，也无法利用反射内容进行场景生成。为了在无需额外训练的情况下解决这一问题，我们的核心思想是将镜像视为两个互补的视角。从输入图像中，我们估计镜面平面并通过对相机位姿进行反射来形成虚拟视角。基于这一虚拟视角设置，我们提出了一种两阶段生成方法，包括镜像门控注意力和反射注入，通过在多视角扩散模型中显式利用反射关系，实现反射一致的新视角合成。Ref-GeNVS 继承了多视角扩散骨干网络强大的泛化能力，同时无需微调。在包含镜子的合成场景和真实场景中，Ref-GeNVS 优于近期的生成式方法。
tldr: 提出无需训练、反射感知的生成式新视角合成方法 Ref-GeNVS，通过将镜像视为互补视角、估计镜面构造虚拟视角，并采用镜像门控注意力与反射注入的两阶段生成策略，在含镜场景中实现反射一致的新视角合成且无需微调。
en_tdlr: Ref-GeNVS is a training-free, reflection-aware generative novel view synthesis method that treats mirror reflections as complementary virtual views and leverages mirror-gated attention with reflection injection to achieve reflection-consistent NVS without finetuning.
